title: Understanding Precision
text: Precision is a measure of how many of the predicted positive cases were actually positive. It's calculated as the number of true positives divided by the total number of predicted positives.

title: Identifying True Positives
text: Look at the predictions and true values. A true positive is when both the predicted and true values are $$1$$. How many true positives do you see?

title: Counting Predicted Positives
text: Predicted positives are all the cases where the predicted value is $$1$$, regardless of the true value. Count these cases to find the total number of predicted positives.

title: Calculate Precision
text: Using the formula for precision, calculate it using the true positives and predicted positives you identified.
